tools.name: searchable_parameters
tools.description: Report effective and disabled parameters for this topology.

tools.name: summarize_search_space
tools.description: List every layered design parameter, its candidates, layer and constraints.

tools.name: inspect_device_config
tools.description: Show the configurable cfgs of one device variant. device_type is the category (e.g. mzm); device_name is a variant from list_device_candidates (e.g. LT_MZM).

tools.name: list_device_candidates
tools.description: List available device variants per device type. device_type is a category (e.g. mzm, photodetector); omit it to list all types.

tools.name: summarize_device_frontier
tools.description: Summarize the Pareto frontier of real device variants per device type. Reports, for each type: compatible variants and their reported speed_GHz/prec_bit/energy_cost+energy_unit/area_mm2, the non-dominated energy/area frontier, dominated variants, and variants excluded by the current work_freq/precision coupling. The energy metric is type-specific: mzm uses efficiency (fJ/bit) and phase_shifter uses P_pi (mW), because their static power is 0; other types use power/dynamic_power (mW). Real reported values only — no interpolation. Pass device_type to restrict to one category (e.g. dac); omit to list all types.

tools.name: summarize_device_provenance
tools.description: Audit device variants as traceable, baseline or placeholder with source records.

tools.name: modify_device_parameter
tools.description: Select a library variant in the active core/node, mesh_core/mesh_node, or weight_array_core/weight_array_node slot.

tools.name: modify_hardware_parameter
tools.description: Apply explicit optical-structure parameter updates.

tools.name: modify_topology_template
tools.description: Switch the optical core to another topology template (core_kind), auto-aligning node_kind.

tools.name: step_hardware_parameter
tools.description: Step one optical-structure parameter to the next candidate.

tools.name: describe_metric_units
tools.description: Authoritative units for simulator metrics and report fields.

tools.name: inspect_layer_details
tools.description: Detailed workload and memory evidence for selected layers.

tools.name: summarize_area_breakdown
tools.description: Per-device and per-chip-type area breakdown (um^2).

tools.name: summarize_device_area_breakdown
tools.description: Per-device area contribution (um^2), ranked high to low. Each row carries level (core/node), device_type, device_name, instance, count, chip_type and total_area_share (fraction of the total).

tools.name: summarize_device_energy_breakdown
tools.description: Per-device energy contribution (pJ), ranked high to low. Each row carries level (core/node), device_type, device_name, instance, count, chip_type and total_energy_share (fraction of the total), so the dominant energy consumer is directly visible.

tools.name: summarize_energy_breakdown
tools.description: Per-device / per-chip-type compute energy plus per-level memory energy (HBM/GLB2/GLB1/RF) and its total.

tools.name: summarize_hardware_config
tools.description: Compact summary of the current photonic architecture and device choices.

tools.name: summarize_insertion_loss
tools.description: Node and core longest optical path insertion loss (dB).

tools.name: summarize_insertion_loss_detail
tools.description: Node/core longest optical paths with per-component insertion loss. Returns node_path/core_path (the instance chain) plus node_path_detail/core_path_detail: one {instance, device_type, device_name, insertion_loss_dB} entry per component along that path, so you can attribute which component loses how many dB (and which dominates).

tools.name: summarize_layer_ranks
tools.description: Rank layers by simulated latency / energy / area cost.

tools.name: summarize_metrics
tools.description: Scalar latency / energy / area metrics and the combined objective.

tools.name: summarize_operator_groups
tools.description: Aggregate cost by operator group (attention / qkv_projection / ffn / convolution / ...).

tools.name: summarize_topology_evidence
tools.description: ONE-CALL topology evidence bundle: optical structure (incl. the device variants actually in use), the insertion-loss totals, the per-component core_component_loss / node_component_loss maps and core_path_detail / node_path_detail lists, plus power_budget_inputs carrying the laser (power, dBm) and photodetector (sensitivity, dBm) cfgs. Prefer this over several separate calls: it is all the loss and power-budget evidence the topology diagnosis needs.

tools.name: summarize_workload_features
tools.description: Deterministic workload fingerprint: layer count, operator groups, cycles and size.

tools.name: evaluate_design
tools.description: HOST ONLY: run one expensive simulator evaluation for a complete hardware design point.

tools.name: preview_evaluation_schema
tools.description: Describe the simulator input, output and search-space contract without running an evaluation.

tools.name: commit_verified_case
tools.description: HOST ONLY: persist one simulator-verified case and its before/after outcome.

tools.name: compare_search_states
tools.description: Compare current / previous / best evaluated design points.

tools.name: retrieve_similar_cases
tools.description: Retrieve top-k prior cases conditioned on bottleneck text and current hardware, including verified outcome labels.

tools.name: select_analysis_base
tools.description: Select which evaluated design point downstream tools use.

tools.name: summarize_case_memory
tools.description: Report total and objectively improved cases in the reusable case memory.

tools.name: summarize_design_identity
tools.description: Compute the canonical hardware fingerprint and report whether it has already been evaluated.

tools.name: summarize_pareto_frontier
tools.description: Return the evaluated non-dominated frontier and its physical minimize axes.

tools.name: summarize_schedule_signals
tools.description: Read maturity and objective-improvement signals used by the deterministic workflow scheduler.

tools.name: inspect_light_path
tools.description: Inspect the ordered optical path and selected device variants.

tools.name: inspect_topology_template
tools.description: Inspect one topology template and its required slots.

tools.name: list_topology_templates
tools.description: List legal topology templates and their coupling matrix.

tools.name: summarize_optical_structure
tools.description: Full circuit-organisation snapshot: core_kind, node_kind, sharing_policy, temporal_accum, laser_distribution, plus geometry/wavelength/clock/precision/dataflow. Also reports the device variants actually in use (core_devices / node_devices / mesh_core_devices / mesh_node_devices), e.g. which laser (off_chip_laser vs on_chip_laser) and phase shifter are selected.

tools.name: summarize_topology
tools.description: Return every topology component and the ordered optical path.

tools.name: validate_coupling
tools.description: Validate cross-layer coupling and physically forced values.

atomic_skills.name: assess_candidate_legality
atomic_skills.goal: 判断当前候选设计是否满足跨层耦合约束
atomic_skills.failure_policy: Return a typed skill error; do not invent missing evidence.

atomic_skills.name: assess_case_reusability
atomic_skills.goal: 判断检索到的历史案例是否包含可复用的已验证改善
required_evidence: retrieval score and verified case outcome
atomic_skills.decision_rule: reusable iff at least one retrieved case has outcome=improved
atomic_skills.failure_policy: Return a typed skill error; do not invent missing evidence.

atomic_skills.name: assess_design_novelty
atomic_skills.goal: 判断当前设计点是否已经被评估
atomic_skills.decision_rule: novel iff fingerprint is not in the evaluated set
atomic_skills.failure_policy: Return a typed skill error; do not invent missing evidence.

atomic_skills.name: assess_memory_energy_dominance
atomic_skills.goal: 判断当前设计是否由存储能耗主导
atomic_skills.failure_policy: Return a typed skill error; do not invent missing evidence.

atomic_skills.name: assess_memory_maturity
atomic_skills.goal: 判断案例记忆是否积累了足够的有效先验
atomic_skills.failure_policy: Return a typed skill error; do not invent missing evidence.

atomic_skills.name: assess_objective_convergence
atomic_skills.goal: 判断搜索目标是否在指定窗口内收敛
atomic_skills.decision_rule: all gains in the full window are <= convergence_delta
atomic_skills.failure_policy: Return a typed skill error; do not invent missing evidence.

atomic_skills.name: assess_objective_improvement
atomic_skills.goal: 判断当前设计相对指定基点是否改善
atomic_skills.failure_policy: Return a typed skill error; do not invent missing evidence.

atomic_skills.name: assess_optical_power_budget
atomic_skills.goal: 判断当前光链路是否满足接收功率预算
atomic_skills.failure_policy: Return a typed skill error; do not invent missing evidence.

atomic_skills.name: assess_parameter_effectiveness
atomic_skills.goal: 判断一个参数在当前拓扑和后端下是否真正生效
atomic_skills.decision_rule: parameter is in searchable; otherwise return the declared disable reason
atomic_skills.failure_policy: Return a typed skill error; do not invent missing evidence.

atomic_skills.name: choose_analysis_baseline
atomic_skills.goal: 选择后续诊断使用的已评估基点
atomic_skills.failure_policy: Return a typed skill error; do not invent missing evidence.

atomic_skills.name: identify_dominant_area_device
atomic_skills.goal: 识别面积占比最高的器件
atomic_skills.failure_policy: Return a typed skill error; do not invent missing evidence.

atomic_skills.name: identify_dominant_energy_device
atomic_skills.goal: 识别能耗占比最高的器件
atomic_skills.failure_policy: Return a typed skill error; do not invent missing evidence.

atomic_skills.name: identify_dominant_optical_loss
atomic_skills.goal: 识别光路中插损最大的组件
atomic_skills.failure_policy: Return a typed skill error; do not invent missing evidence.

atomic_skills.name: identify_latency_hotspot
atomic_skills.goal: 识别当前工作负载的主要时延热点层
atomic_skills.failure_policy: Return a typed skill error; do not invent missing evidence.

atomic_skills.name: select_device_frontier_candidate
atomic_skills.goal: 按指定优化方向选择一个兼容器件变体
atomic_skills.decision_rule: minimum requested cost or minimum joint rank on the Pareto frontier
atomic_skills.failure_policy: Return a typed skill error; do not invent missing evidence.
